issues.description: The solution's Developer initializer includes an extra parameter `age: Int` that is not present in the problem specification or the template. The template and problem require an initializer that accepts only `name` and `monthsOfSwiftExperience`. Additionally, the solution's Client calls the two-parameter initializer (name, monthsOfSwiftExperience) while the solution's Developer init requires three parameters, which will cause a compilation error and confuses students about the intended constructor signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Developer initializer match the problem and template by removing the extra `age: Int` parameter so the signature is `init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?)`. Ensure any callers (e.g. Client) use the same two-parameter initializer. If `age` was intentionally added, update the problem statement, template, and all call sites to include and document the new parameter consistently.
